judgments.reason: The model only reports filing and redeeming actions and that “seal accepts a report equal to your digit”; it does not articulate or test the mechanism that inflated reports congruent mod seven are accepted and credited.

The model never hypothesizes or demonstrates that an audited original is overridden by an amendment or that amendment precedence produces the claimed effect; it only describes filing the true digit and redeeming the certificate.

The model never suggests or shows that the same certificate can be redeemed multiple times; it redeems once and repeatedly files reports but provides no mechanism or evidence of repeated 4-point payments from one serial.

The model does not claim the clerk reveals accepted inflated reports nor articulate how such a meta-rule would operate; its text only makes ordinary filing and redemption moves without revealing or leveraging clerk receipts.
